rationale: The material prompt requirement is End-to-end local containerized database setup with authenticated registry image retrieval, secret placeholders, readiness waiting, application database creation, application connection environment setting, post-database seed ordering, and an engine-verification query.. At # Test Data Builder, the source is scoped to Builds realistic domain fixtures, factories, and edge-case datasets with the builder pattern and valid defaults, so each test owns exactly the data it asserts on. Use when someone asks "how should I set up test data", "my fixtures broke half the suite", "make a factory for this model", "why is this test flaky only in CI", or a test needs domain objects, seed; that scope does not provide a plausible route to the required input/output boundary.
